description: Main application component for a TodoMVC app using React, managing todo items, filtering, and rendering the UI.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: React component managing the TodoMVC application's state and rendering.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes routing and sets up event handlers after component mounts.

methods.name: handleNewTodoKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down event for creating new todo items.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles all todos as completed or active.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion state of a specific todo.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Sets a todo item into editing mode.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves changes to a todo item.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the TodoMVC UI based on current state.
